title: The Famine Relief Convoy
logline: A massive humanitarian grain convoy arrives in a recovered star system after an eight-month voyage, only to be denied docking because free grain will ruin local farmers.

roles.description: Master of the bulk humanitarian grain armada; exhausted, rigidly bound by delivery charter clauses.
Trade officer of the recovering agricultural system; desperate to prevent a catastrophic local grain market crash.
Regional commissioner who funded the convoy; determined to collect performance bonuses regardless of local impact.
A heavy private security frigate escorting the humanitarian haulers through regional jump lanes.
The league of local agricultural producers whose recovering harvest faces market annihilation.
The intersystem charitable logistics conglomerate operating subsidized food relief fleets.
An intermediate depot where regional grain fleets muster before the final jump.
The fortified jump transit terminal where inbound commercial traffic is inspected and cleared.

public_situation: A massive humanitarian grain convoy arrives in {system} after an eight-month voyage, only to find the local famine has ended and the system refuses docking clearance.
private_truth: The relief trust deliberately stalled the fleet's departure for two months to collect higher emergency freight subsidies, arriving long after local crops recovered.

beats.public_change: Customs authorities at {role:staging_outpost} freeze docking slots as the grain fleet arrives to find local silos already brimming.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to scan the lead hauler's original departure manifests to prove the fleet launched months after the famine peak.
missions.private_fact: If forty thousand tons of free grain are dumped on station docks, every independent farmer in the system will go bankrupt.

missions.reason: He needs immediate water ice deliveries to maintain cooling scrubbers on the packed grain holds while the fleet remains stalled in orbit.
missions.private_fact: His crews are on half-pay and will mutiny if the armada is turned back without collecting its delivery vouchers.

beats.public_change: Armed picket vessels deployed by {role:growers_consortium} form an interdiction perimeter around the regional jump corridor.

missions.reason: She hires a courier to serve an enforceable intersystem emergency covenant warrant to force the gate authority to open transit.
missions.private_fact: Her lucrative executive bonus requires successful cargo handover within seventy-two hours of the fiscal quarter's close.

beats.public_change: The convoy's escort frigate powers weapons, preparing to force transit past the local growers' picket craft.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to disable the escort frigate's drive arrays before it opens fire on civilian farm picket vessels.
missions.private_fact: The escort captain hails mid-fight offering fifty thousand credits to clear a path through the picket lines for the haulers.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to recover the armada's charter deed from the disabled flagship to authorize an emergency cargo reroute.
missions.private_fact: He would rather divert the grain to a distant industrial reprocessing belt at a loss than ruin the farmers who welcomed him.

beats.public_change: Freight syndicates from adjacent industrial systems converge at {role:quarantine_gate} to bid on the stranded grain tonnage.

missions.reason: He needs the pilot to purchase emergency fuel canisters at a neighboring outpost to supply the haulers for a diverted jump.
missions.private_fact: Local growers chipped in their seasonal savings to pay for the fuel so the grain would leave their space.

player_choice.prompt: The relief fleet is cleared for its final jump. Forcing delivery will bankrupt local growers; diverting it leaves the relief crews unpaid; offloading at an industrial belt preserves both sides at a steep financial loss.

options.label: Enforce full dockside delivery to collect the relief subsidies, collapsing local grain prices
Turn the armada away without payment, saving local growers while financially destroying the relief crews
Divert the grain to industrial bio-fuel refineries, splitting losses evenly across both factions

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot enforces the relief charter and dumps the food on destination stations.
resolutions.summary: Forty thousand tons of free grain flood the markets. Food prices collapse to zero, bankrupting {role:growers_consortium} and triggering widespread farm foreclosures.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced a delayed relief convoy through customs, collapsing a star system's farming economy.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blocks the fleet from docking or the armada charter is voided.
resolutions.summary: The armada is turned away without compensation. {role:relief_commodore} declares bankruptcy and scuttles the spoiling cargo in deep space.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot negotiates a diversion to neighboring industrial fuel processors.
resolutions.summary: The surplus grain is processed into ship propellant. Both farmers and haulers absorb moderate financial losses, avoiding mutual ruin.

loose_threads.detail: The grain containers bear freight escalation stamps dated six weeks after the destination declared its harvest safe.
An internal audit bulletin lists six-figure performance bonuses tied to landing the relief convoy before quarter end.
Short positions against local agricultural cooperatives were bought through an offshore bank days before the fleet arrived.

radio_hooks: Humanitarian grain armada arrives to find local famine resolved; docking privileges withheld.
Local agricultural consortium threatens armed resistance if foreign relief grain is unloaded.
Relief trust petitions sector governor to enforce emergency delivery treaties across disputed systems.

voice_direction.relief_commodore: Hoarse, stoic, and exasperated. Speaks with the fatigue of an honest freighter captain caught between predatory directors and hostile farmers.
voice_direction.destination_bailiff: Shrill, panicky, and urgent. Pleads with economic figures and describes the bankruptcy of fifty farming settlements if the food lands.
voice_direction.relief_director: Crisp, cold, and litigious. Treats starving populations and market crashes as administrative line items in a quarterly performance review.
